import json, subprocess, sys
req = open('/app/examples/request.jsonl','rb').read()
ref = json.loads(open('/app/examples/response.jsonl').read())
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/app/submission/planner.py'], input=req, capture_output=True)
got = json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
def norm(d):
    if isinstance(d, dict): return {k: norm(v) for k,v in sorted(d.items())}
    if isinstance(d, list): return [norm(v) for v in d]
    if isinstance(d, str): return d
    return round(float(d), 12)
print("identical values (modulo key order & int/float):", norm(ref) == norm(got))
PYEOF
